extraction.notes: Three-month (Q3 2023) column only. Starting line and FFO/Core FFO taken from the reconciliation table (seq 14, printed page 11); AFFO from the AFFO table (seq 15, no printed page number in marker). FFO, Core FFO and Core AFFO all tie to the printed totals. Zero-amount lines (dashes in the Q3 column) are included as 0. Classification judgement calls: 'Amortization of derivative premium' mapped to debt_cost_amortization (not a fair-value change); 'Land and other impairments' mapped to other (zero this quarter); Rockpoint buyout premium, redemption value adjustment and lease breakage fee mapped to other. 'Amortization of lease inducements' and 'Amortization of market lease intangibles' mapped to straight_line_rent as similar non-cash revenue items. Per-share check: -34,759/100,925 = -0.34; 11,606/100,925 = 0.12. Company does not report an AFFO per share figure. AFFO already deducts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Page 35 statement uses slightly different labels (e.g., 'Severance/Compensation related costs (Real Estate Services and Operating Expenses)') but identical amounts.
